items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Howard -- Mr. Howard who owns the Zanzibar -- wanted a quick show, he would tell Claude -- he says, 'I want you to take' -- tell Claude to let me take the show down

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

what --
On a Saturday night, they had -- Claude
had probably -- some of the guys I had when we was
in Louie's band, you know. They was backing the band
and they knew -- well, you know, they worked under
me as music director.
So what happened was, on a Saturday
night or Sunday night or Friday night, when the
Zanzibar would be real packed, and Howard -- Mr. Howard
who owns the Zanzibar -- wanted a quick show, he
would tell Claude -- he says, "I want you to take" --
tell Claude to let me take the show down, because…
Do his introduction -- he would do his band number and then I'd conduct the show all the way through. The show would move. Really move.
